what: Behind the button lies a triangle grid with side length (font size × .25, 9~30px), and a ripple spreading from one point switches the outlines of the triangles it passes on and off in the text color — triangle by triangle in turn = From the wave point, distance / farthest distance × .82 + noise × .18, flashing to .55 at the leading edge, then fading .35 → 0 over .3. On hover it runs 1.6s from that spot. When more than 75% is on screen and there is no hover, it sweeps once as a glint every 4–9 seconds from the left center in 2.4s. The edge is softened by a round mask.

options.side: Triangle side length (px), default font size × .25 clamped to 9~30
options.idle: Idle shimmer duration (seconds), default 2.4 — 0 means no idle shimmer
options.every: Pause (seconds) between resting sparkles, range in 「4 9」 format, default 4 9

use: Let's talk. · Without the resting glint: data-fx-tri-glint-sweep="idle: 0"

from.where: index.html .ap-link·.ap-steps__cta·.ap-footer__email (original [data-triangle-button] triangle cover — sparkle 2.4s · 4~9s rest · interaction 1.6s)
